approved: Telecommunications (Interception and Access) Amendment (Corrective Services Authorities) Bill 2022

The bill amends the Telecommunications (Interception and Access) Act to allow corrective services authorities to access telecommunications data to combat illicit mobile phone use in prisons, implementing a recommendation from the comprehensive review of the national intelligence community's legal framework. A temporary declaration under section 176A has already given Corrective Services NSW this access, and Operation Ironside has resulted in over 350 individuals being charged.
